args.goal: Showcase: crewed Mun landing and return with Lander 3 (wide 2.5 m base). MechJeb flies the ascent and trans-Mun injection; ASTRA fly_descent lands (cancelling drift before contact); Jebediah plants a flag and comes home.

result.goal: Showcase: crewed Mun landing and return with Lander 3 (wide 2.5 m base). MechJeb flies the ascent and trans-Mun injection; ASTRA fly_descent lands (cancelling drift before contact); Jebediah plants a flag and comes home.
relevant_lessons: - [2026-09-30] (landing, design) Four LT-2 legs on a 1.25 m FL-T400 still tipped: touching down with 2.1 m/s sideways on a 4 deg slope loads one leg and throws the tall stack over as soon as the autopilot lets go. Cancel drift before contact (hover a few metres up) and give the lander a wide, low base (2.5 m tank, legs at 1.25 m radius).

- [2026-06-27] (landing) Mun terminal-descent failures: a fixed 30 m suicide-burn margin forced near-full throttle near the ground (bounce, drift, dry tanks); a capped hover from 250 m oscillated and burned the return fuel; lateral cleanup starting at 120 m with 7.5 m/s sideways was too late (impact at 18.8 m/s); switching to vertical while drifting preserved the slide. Null the horizontal speed before contact and stay retrograde until it is small.

- [2026-09-30] (landing, design, eva) A 3-legged single-stack Mun lander (FL-T400 + Terrier, pod on top, LT-2 legs) rocked +-7 deg on a 5.7 deg slope and fell over twice: once when the kerbal dropped out of the hatch, once after the vessel switch that follows boarding. Use 4 legs or a wider base, and lift off promptly after boarding.

- [2026-06-27] (landing, design) A lander engine enclosed by its own interstage shroud had its exhaust blocked: full throttle, fuel draining, g-force 0 (an LV-N at trans-Mun injection). Engines that stay attached must have bare bells.

- [2026-06-27] (landing, design, eva) A tall, narrow single-stack lander tipped over on Duna, burying the hatch and blocking both the flag and the ascent. Design for a tip-over angle well above the expected slopes (wide stance, low centre of mass) and check tilt before any surface ignition.

- [2026-06-27] (mun, transfer, landing) Finite-burn execution erased ~19 km of planned Mun periapsis (33.7 km planned, 14.4 km actual); planned periapses under ~45 km were unsafe for that craft, and "periapsis > 0" is not landing-safe because terrain rises many kilometres. The first Mun relay impacted after warping straight into a −40 km predicted periapsis: read the prediction and correct before warping in.

- [2026-06-27] (mechjeb, mun, transfer) MechJeb's planners ignore the Mun: a Kerbin ejection whose path crossed the Mun's SOI was deflected. Check the predicted patch chain for intermediate moon encounters before burning.

- [2026-06-27] (mechjeb, staging, capture) MechJeb's StagingController is separate from the ascent autostage flag: the landing autopilot and an autostaging ascent leave it active, and it autostages during ANY later burn. It fired a heat-shield/payload decoupler mid-capture and stranded a crew pod at Eve with no engine, shield, or chutes. Release it before every in-space burn.

args.text: Lander 3 (wide base). MechJeb ascent to 80 km with auto-staging down to stage 3; the Mainsail leaves ~250 m/s short of orbit, so MechJeb stages to the transfer Terrier to finish. Then MechJeb trans-Mun injection, ASTRA capture, drift-cancelling descent, EVA, flag, return.
